references.text: Direct continuation of the same conflict scene where the accusations between the parties meet.
Theological parallel in the defense of the innocent: 'What have I done?' against an unreasonable accusation.
Direct dialogue pair: Jacob's accusation of sin meets Laban's response regarding ownership and power.
Recurring motif: Jacob's accusation, 'What have you done to me?', confronting Laban's deception.
Thematic parallel: Jacob's fear of being destroyed or hated because of others' sin.
